idea.title: The Bell Dogs
idea.setting: a small town where every dog wears a bell
idea.opener: In this town, every dog wears a bell.
idea.premise: Every dog in town wears a bell so nobody gets lost. My dog Biscuit loses his bell and gets lost.
idea.twist: Biscuit was not lost: he followed the sound of his own bell to bring it home.
idea.closer: In this town, every dog wears a bell. Biscuit wears two now.

lines.text: In this town, every dog wears a bell.
When a dog runs down the street, you hear it ring.
I'm Mia, and this is my dog Biscuit.
Biscuit is a little brown dog with a red collar.
His bell is the loudest one on our street.
One morning, Biscuit came home without his bell.
He sniffed the ground and barked at the gate.
Then Biscuit ran away down the street.
I looked for him in the park.
I called his name by the fountain.
Then I heard a tiny ring from the woods.
Biscuit was sitting under a tree.
His bell was hanging from a low branch.
He barked at it, wagging his tail.
He was never lost. He was finding his bell.
We walked home together, and the bell rang all the way.
In this town, every dog wears a bell. Biscuit wears two now.
